Metadata.title: Relay AI
Metadata.description: Answers first. Humans when it matters. A support chatbot for small web shops.

Home.title: Answers first. Humans when it matters.
Home.lead: Add your FAQ, paste one line of code on your shop, and your visitors get instant answers. When the bot doesn't know, the chat comes to you.

preview.label: Example conversation
preview.visitor: How long do I have to return shoes?
preview.bot: You can return unworn shoes within 14 days of delivery. The return label is in your parcel.

Footer.note: Portfolio project. Runs on free tiers, with no real charges.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your Relay dashboard.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: The free plan is free for good. No card needed.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If there's an account for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires soon.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll stay signed in after saving it.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and only for a short time. Ask for a new one.

Errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox for the link.

empty.title: No bots yet

fields.name: Bot name
fields.nameHint: Shown at the top of the chat, for example “Kroj Support”.
fields.descriptionHint: What you sell, your tone, and topics the bot should stay away from.
fields.defaultLanguageHint: Used when a visitor writes in neither English nor Serbian.
fields.brandColorHint: Text on top of it is picked automatically so it stays readable.
fields.activeHint: When it's off, the widget tells visitors chat is unavailable.

logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 200 KB. Square works best.
logo.none: No logo yet. The chat shows your bot's initial instead.

origins.label: Allowed websites
origins.hint: The widget answers only on these addresses, for example https://kroj.rs.
origins.empty: No websites yet. Until you add one, the widget won't answer on any site.

questions.label: Quick questions
questions.hint: Up to 3 per language, shown as buttons when the chat opens.

embed.title: Add it to your shop
embed.body: Paste this line just before </body> on every page where the chat should appear.
embed.copyFailed: Copy didn't work. Select the text and copy it yourself.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: A static preview of how the chat will look. The working widget arrives in a later update.
preview.subtitle: Usually replies right away

danger.title: Delete this bot
danger.body: This deletes the bot, its FAQ and every conversation with it. It can't be undone.
